description: This file provides utility functions for tenant management in a frontend web application. It includes functions to normalize tenant IDs, get/set/clear active tenant markers in local storage, fetch tenant data from a backend session API, and select a tenant via a backend POST request. The code relies on browser APIs like fetch and localStorage, and is designed to support frontend tenant routing and selection within a user session.

methods.name: normalizeTenantId(t)
methods.description: Extracts and normalizes a tenant ID from various object structures or string input.

methods.name: getActiveTenant()
methods.description: Retrieves the current active tenant ID from local storage, with fallback to legacy key for backward compatibility.

methods.name: setActiveTenant(tenantId)
methods.description: Sets or removes the active tenant ID in local storage, ensuring legacy keys are cleaned up.

methods.name: clearActiveTenant()
methods.description: Removes the active tenant marker from local storage.

methods.name: fetchSessionTenants()
methods.description: Fetches the list of authorized tenants for the current session via API.

methods.name: selectTenant(tenantId, reason = 'user-selection')
methods.description: Sets the active tenant both via backend API (cookie-based) and updates local storage markers.
